subject.title: chore(ci): enforce changed-file TypeScript LOC ratchet

question: Should OpenClaw permanently enforce the 500-line changed-production-TypeScript ratchet and the associated exact-PR release-gate dispatch contract?
rationale: The implementation changes repository-wide contributor and release operations, while the canonical issue remains labeled as needing a product decision and this PR carries the protected maintainer label.

options.title: Adopt the hard ratchet
options.body: Fix the generated declaration exclusion, retain the hard changed-file gate, and merge after focused workflow checks complete.

options.title: Start advisory-only
options.body: Report changed-file growth without failing CI until maintainers have observed the policy against normal contribution and generation workflows.

options.title: Decline the policy
options.body: Keep file-size enforcement as review guidance and close the implementation without adding a mandatory CI gate.

recommendation.title: Adopt the hard ratchet
recommendation.body: Fix the generated declaration exclusion, retain the hard changed-file gate, and merge after focused workflow checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest demonstrated connection to the CI, release-gate, and LOC-policy implementation and is already carrying the associated issue and PR.
